sequences.name: Hunter
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Inhuman physical qualities including increased strength, speed, reaction, body control, and natural healing.
Heightened Senses: Enhanced auditory, olfactory, and visual senses for strong tracking.
Spirituality: Slightly enhanced Spirituality.
Ritualistic Magic: Can learn and cast basic Ritualistic Magic.
Spirit Vision: Can learn to use Spirit Vision through Cogitation.
Danger Intuition: Can passively sense ill intentions and danger.
Knowledge (Survival, Traps): Knowledge on how to survive in the wilderness and place traps.

sequences.name: Provoker
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Slightly stronger physique, strength, reflexes, speed, and agility.
Spirituality: Slightly enhanced Spirituality.
Spirit Vision: Can activate Spirit Vision smoothly using a simple gesture.
Provocation: Can induce permanent state change and discern which words/actions most easily trigger agitation.

sequences.name: Pyromaniac (Fire Mage)
abilities: Spirituality: Remarkable improvement in Spirituality.
Spirit Vision: Can discreetly activate Spirit Vision and discern Ether Body components.
Danger Intuition: Enhanced; can activate pre-emptively.
Pyrokinesis: Freely control and conjure flames within vicinity.
Compression: Can compress flames for more potent strikes.
Fire Armor: Can ignite Flame Armor over body for defense.
Conjure Flames: Can conjure temporary weapons using flames.
Fire Ravens: Summons multiple ravens made of fire for interception and locking-on.
Wall of Fire: Summons flaming serpents to erect a scorching barrier.
Blazing Spear: Creates a spear of blazing-white fire for high damage.
Giant Fireball: Compression of crimson Fireballs into a devastating blast.
Fire Resistance: Remarkable resistance to flames.

sequences.name: Conspirer
sequences.description: The Conspirer's direct destructive capability is ranked in the upper-tier among Sequence 6s.
abilities: Enhanced Mental Attributes: Enhanced insight, sharper thinking, and intelligence.
Information-Gathering: Enhanced five senses and spiritual perception.
Physical Enhancement: Improved physique.
Spirituality: Enhanced Spirituality.
Incitement (Instigation): Can incite thoughts or desires through conversation.
Misdirection, Confusion, Deception (Conspiracy): Core aspects of manipulation.
Flame Transformation: Can merge with fire weapons and travel to destination.
Pyrokinesis: Improved precise control over flames; flames become crimson-white.

sequences.name: Reaper
sequences.description: The Reaper has the highest damage output between all Sequence 5 Beyonders.
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Improved strength, speed, and endurance.
Spirituality: Enhanced to a significant degree.
Enhanced Mental Attributes: Clearer thinking.
Weakness Investigation: Can discern vulnerabilities and weak points.
Cull: Can infuse attacks to harvest target's life, striking vital points.
Precision: Can precisely target predetermined locations and carefully manipulate Fire Spells.
Pyrokinesis: Enhanced flame manipulation.

sequences.name: Iron-blooded Knight
abilities: Gender Transition: Advancement results in becoming male regardless of original gender.
Courage: High resistance against mental attacks and fear.
Physical Enhancement: Can fight against Twilight Giant Pathway Giants or Dragons.
Weaponizing: Can turn ordinary objects into terrifying murderous weapons.
Chain of Command: Hidden connection with those under their command.
Communication: Can share senses between troops.
Strength Concentration: Can focus the power of their army onto themselves.
Alleviation: Can spread damage on themselves to their troops.
Galvanization: Can transform body and flames into steel.
Pyrokinesis: Heat from flames increases exponentially; flames become bluish-white.
Cull: Reached Demigod level potency.
Mythical Creature Form: Incomplete Calamity Giant.

sequences.name: War Bishop
abilities: War Song & War Cry: Can yell out a War Cry or sing a War Song to enhance allies and weaken enemies.
Fog of War: Disrupts senses of anyone within and isolates connections.
Sacrifice: Can petition the Essence of War or Symbolism of War for assistance.
Gathering: Can gather power from their army and impart own power to troops.
Chain of Command: Enhanced; can unleash the true strength of an army.
Crowd Control: Can fortify and connect members to resist outside interference.
Communication: Enhanced; can pass down messages and selectively shield/modify information.
Pyrokinesis: Flames become pure azure with enhanced destructive power.
Mythical Creature Form: Can respond to prayers.

sequences.name: Weather Warlock
abilities: Charm: Makes people want to follow and be loyal.
Information-Gathering: Enhanced ability to extract and restore environmental information.
Physical Enhancement: Enhanced strength and stamina.
Spirituality: Enhanced amount of Spirituality.
War Song & War Cry: Can let out a soul-shaking, chilling cry.
Weather (Weather Manipulation): Partial authority over Weather.
Gathering: Can concentrate and Gather strength within a 10 kilometer range.
Weaponizing: Can make materials as strong as the Sword of Courage.
Pyrokinesis: Flames glow violet-tinged azure.
Compression: Compressed fireball's explosive power far surpasses fleet's main guns.
Flame Transformation: Can turn into a stream of flame or flaming meteor.
Weakness Investigation: Enhanced scope including Substitutes, Avatars, and manifestations.
Cull: Greatly enhanced power.
Galvanization: Ability to turn into steel closer to symbolism of 'steel'.
Chain of Command: Massively enhanced hidden line of command.
Fog of War: Greatly enhanced; can expand to 20 kilometers.
Sacrifice: Can petition Essence of War once every week.
Tracking: Advanced Tracking skills.
Mythical Creature Form: Complete 5-6 meter tall Calamity Giant.

sequences.name: Conqueror
abilities: Conquest & War: Part of the Conquest and War authorities.
Conquest: Can make target's body, mind, and spirit want to submit.
Puppets into Soldiers (Casting Beans into Soldiers): Can Conquer inanimate objects to turn into soldiers.
Gathering: Gathered power can undergo qualitative transformation.
War Commander: Can establish a temporary team of unlimited size.
Sacrifices: Can achieve power burst similar to Hand of God.
Spear of Destruction: Cull ability undergoes qualitative transformation.
Galvanization: Enhanced ability to turn flames and body into steel.
Pyrokinesis: Flames burn in pure violet color.
Weaponizing: Can coalesce fog into a spear-like weapon capable of shattering mountain peaks.

sequences.name: Red Priest
sequences.description: 'Red' represents the color of War, and 'Priest' can be understood as a ritual of strength.
abilities: Lord of War: Can share power, rank, and Uniqueness across an entire planet.
Conquest: Authority can extend to territories and abstract concepts.
War: Can cause War to break out in a target area through mere gaze or presence.
Courage: Subsidiary authority of War; Courage of mind means no fear.
Fog of War: At True Deity level, can affect even the Astral World.
Destruction: Can shatter an entire planet or kill a True God.
Flames: Lesser authority of Destruction; formless and colorless Flame.
Disaster: Lesser authority of Destruction; master of various calamities.
Sacrifices: Can influence and interfere with any Sacrificial Ritual.
Charm: Possesses a certain degree of Charm authority.
Masculinity: Authority over Male forces and concepts.
